meta.episode: stETH / Celsius -- Curve stETH/ETH realisable discount
meta.direction: get_dy(1, 0, X) = sell stETH (coin 1) for ETH (coin 0)
meta.reads_per_point: 7 eth_call per point (4 get_dy + 2 balances + 1 Chainlink), plus 2-3 eth_getBlockByNumber for the block floor
meta.scope: Curve stETH/ETH pool; discount = 1 - ETH obtained / stETH sold, fees and slippage included; the 'price' is what a sale realises, not what a screen shows

events.label: Terra/UST collapse drags the whole LST complex; stETH discount opens
Celsius suspends withdrawals (12-13 June); exit liquidity already gone
worst of the episode: 6.19 % to sell 1 stETH on Curve (block 14 970 000)

reference_points.note: worst measured discount of the episode: 6.19 %

limitations: Curve get_dy is a quote, not a fill: it assumes the pool state at that block and ignores gas, and it does not model the CEX exits that were also available in June 2022.
The Chainlink STETH / ETH feed answered with an 18-decimal ratio whose last update can be hours old; age_seconds is recorded for every point where latestRoundData is available.
Lido's redemption was not open in 2022 (withdrawals came with Shapella, April 2023): the Curve pool was the only on-chain exit, which is exactly what makes this discount the realisable price.
